address: Via Spiaggie Rosse, località Mazzotta, Isola di Capo Rizzuto, 88841, Italy
bio: Despite its rural setting inland, this restaurant is still situated within the Capo Rizzuto e Mar Ionio protected marine reserve, which helps to explain the focus on fish and seafood dishes demonstrated by owner-chef Natale Pallone on the menu. The wine cellar boasts over 200 different wines and more than 60 internationally renowned spirits....
